findings.message: The layout says Launch speed 10 with Gravity 1 should read 0 to 10 s, because the fast case is stated as such. The scrubber range is [0,20]. At the default speed the range is 0 to 1.02 s, which is 2u/g, so 20 s is consistent with 2u/g for this case. The plan's layout text gives different numbers for other inputs. The apex at 10 s is the midpoint of the range, so the range itself is consistent, but I could not confirm it against the layout text, which has no entry for speed 10 with gravity 1. The plot time axis is fixed at 0 to 20 s while the default scrubber range is only 1.02 s, so the default case uses 5% of the plot width and the line is cramped.

The height ruler runs to 52.5 m, so the default apex of 1.28 m is only about 4 px above the launch mark (ball y 238.7 vs 243). The ball barely moves, and the top is not visibly higher. The observation that the ball's position follows the motion cannot be seen at the default inputs. The ruler is fixed to the highest possible top.

The acceleration arrow is 122 px long and the velocity arrow is 75 px for 5 m/s. The arrow for a = 9.8 extends to y=365, below the scene box, which ends at y=279. This is outside the lane. The arrow is also longer than the ruler allows.
